weekly_technicals.feature: Weekly hammer -> reversal (the W31 hammer, resolved this week)
weekly_technicals.value: SPY and QQQ both printed a weekly hammer in W31 (lower_low TRUE, lower wick 0.80/0.78 of range, body_frac 0.11) and W32 delivered +3.18% / +5.05%. The pattern 'worked' as textbook as it ever will. PANEL WHAT-IF (indices, full 5-day weeks): n=8 occurrences, mean next-week return -0.71%, up only 3 of 8. The two hammers that fired this week (SPY 07-27 -> +3.18%, QQQ 07-27 -> +5.05%) are the TWO BEST observations in the entire sample; the other six average -2.32% (IWM 04-27 +1.96%, QQQ 05-18 -4.34%, QQQ 06-08 -4.78%, QQQ 07-06 -3.12%, SPY 02-02 -1.11%, SPY 06-08 -2.50%).
weekly_technicals.would_signal: Bullish reversal off a weekly low. A feature whose sign flips entirely on 2 of 8 observations is noise. This is precisely the week in which a Layer-3 pattern felt most compelling and would have been most dangerous to size -- which is the entire reason this layer exists.
weekly_technicals.pre_reg_bar: PR-WT: >=2yr / >=30 weekly obs per arm / cross-regime sign-stable / BH FDR 0.10. Panel is 29 weeks (23 full). n=8 and a NEGATIVE panel mean. Nowhere near the bar.

weekly_technicals.value: All three indices: body_frac 0.81-0.85, close_pos 0.86-0.87, higher_high TRUE, lower wick 0.02-0.06. PANEL WHAT-IF: n=7 matured occurrences, mean next-week +2.12%, up 6 of 7 -- superficially the strongest weekly-technical result on the panel. IT IS AN ARTIFACT. All seven come from just THREE calendar weeks (2026-04-06, 04-13, 05-04) counted across three highly-correlated indices, and all three sit inside the same April-May post-drawdown rebound episode.
weekly_technicals.would_signal: Continuation into the next 1-2 weeks. Effective independent N is approximately 3, all in ONE regime episode -- this is the cluster trap the calibration-audit book already documented (per-name/per-index stats faking the N and manufacturing false significance). Aggregated to the episode it carries no information whatsoever.
weekly_technicals.pre_reg_bar: PR-WT. Fails on effective-N before it fails on anything else. Must be aggregated to the episode/cluster, never counted per-index.
